title: Kitsune Samurai Blood Moon Tough Phone Case | Japanese Dark Fantasy Dual-Layer Cover
description:
Protect your phone in premium artisan style with the Kitsune Samurai Blood Moon Tough Phone Case.

Designed for the Japanese Dark Fantasy collection, this case combines high-impact shock absorption with edge-to-edge full-bleed artwork that will not fade, scratch, or peel.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:
- Dual-layer protection: Impact-resistant Polycarbonate outer shell + Shock-absorbing TPU silicone liner
- Full-bleed 300 DPI sublimation printing with rich saturated pigments
- Engineered camera bezel with 35% upper safe zone protection
- Wireless charging (Qi & MagSafe compatible)
- Available for Apple iPhone & Samsung Galaxy flagship models

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:
Wipe clean with a damp microfiber cloth. Mild soap may be used if needed.
prompt: Full-bleed 9:16 vertical phone case artwork. Masked kitsune samurai warrior in ornate crimson haori wielding glowing katana in lower 65% canvas. Top 35% safe zone features massive radiant blood moon and drifting storm clouds. Clustered red spider lilies at base. Midnight obsidian and liquid gold came lines. Pure graphic design, no mockups, no phone borders.
